question: Can an exact same-geography PyAEZ challenger be run for circa-1337 crop, soil, temperature, precipitation, terrain and water constraints, rather than relabeling GAEZ fallbacks as PyAEZ?

target_definition.temporal_interpretation: nearest centennial step (approximately 1350 CE when BP is referenced to 1950); not exact 1337 climate

current_fallback_artifact.source_engine_semantics: all rows are GAEZ v5-derived physical fallbacks, not PyAEZ executions

runtime_probe.interpretation: The package is installed, but its GDAL/osgeo-backed simulation modules cannot execute in the current locked environment; the contract Python version also does not match the project runtime.

climate.coverage: global centennial climatology; nearest-step approximation to 1337
climate.current_policy: ancillary fields may be constructed from pinned TraCE21ka anomalies plus modern CHELSA reference, but this requires a resolved, tested method registry and is not direct 1337 observation

soil.source: HWSD v2 database/raster and FAO technical report
soil.current_policy: no median or regional soil fill; unresolved soil method blocks exact run

crop_parameters.interpretation: GAEZ v5 appendices can inform a reviewed crop-parameter adaptation, but they are not interchangeable with official PyAEZ crop LUTs. Every crop and both water modes require an explicit cited mapping and hash before promotion.

terrain_and_water.interpretation: River presence or modern irrigated acreage must not be substituted for a PyAEZ irrigated simulation or a 1337-feasible water budget.

crop_registry.blocking_reason: all 23 template crop records remain parameter_state_not_resolved

method_registry.blocking_reason: required method choices and reproducible environment lock are not complete

hard_blockers_before_exact_challenger: Provide an isolated reproducible PyAEZ runtime with GDAL/osgeo and numba, or a validated equivalent container; reconcile contract Python 3.11 with the project runtime policy.
Run and archive a maize rain-fed and irrigated smoke test at one known footprint before scaling.

Resolve and hash PyAEZ-compatible crop parameters and constraint LUTs for all 23 registered crops; any GAEZ-to-PyAEZ adaptation must be cited and labeled as adaptation, never as an official PyAEZ table.
Resolve all method-registry fields, including ancillary climate derivation, no-leap/vertical/time decoding, HWSD component/depth mapping, slope, LGP, thermal climate, permafrost and LUT selection.
Resolve pre-1337 irrigation, terrace and lifting technology and water-budget rules; do not use a has-river shortcut.
Execute exact same-footprint PyAEZ outputs for every crop and water mode and verify one classified row per location × crop × mode × engine.
Compare exact PyAEZ output against the current GAEZ fallback, retain disagreement as uncertainty, and only then permit challenger training.
prohibited_shortcuts: Relabeling the current GAEZ fallback parquet as PyAEZ.
Copying rain-fed yields into irrigated fields.
Filling missing crop parameters with regional or global medians.
Calling 600 BP climate an exact 1337 climate record.
Treating zeros in a fallback matrix as evidence that an exact PyAEZ source was run.
recommended_execution_order: Build the locked runtime and run the one-crop PyAEZ smoke test.
Resolve the crop and method registries with hashes and citations.
Run exact location-footprint labels for both water modes.
Audit row closure, source semantics, and engine disagreement.
Only after closure, fit and compare the mechanistic model and challengers.
